title: Sharp Observability Costs for Strongly Coupled Parabolic Systems with Vanishing Principal Coupling
summary: We study the loss of observability for a class of strongly coupled parabolic systems as the coupling parameter tends to zero. The system is observed through a fixed matrix $B$ on a measurable subset of space-time with positive measure. Under the Kalman rank condition, we determine the exact blow-up rates of the optimal observability cost. Different components of the state, as well as different combinations of them, may have different blow-up rates, and these rates are determined by the algebraic structure of the pair $(B,K)$.
